title: 第17章 暗涌 上第18章 暗涌 中
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
那年轻男人站在石阶上方，居高临下地看着刘叙白。晨光从他背后打过来，在他的银线梅袍上镀了一层冷调的光晕，让他整个人看起来像一柄镶了银边的剑——华丽、锋利，而且毫不掩饰自己的锋芒。
他身后的两个随从弟子也停下了脚步，一左一右立在石阶两侧，双手抱胸，目光里带着毫不掩饰的审视。路过的普通弟子纷纷加快脚步绕开，没有一个人敢停下来看热闹。
刘叙白在心里叹了口气。来画梅宗不到一天，麻烦就找上门了，效率比阴阳门还高。
“正是。”他不卑不亢地抱了抱拳，“青石镇散修刘叙白，不知阁下是？”
年轻男人没有回礼。他只是微微偏了偏头，目光在刘叙白腰间那柄裂纹剑上又停了半息，嘴角浮起一丝似笑非笑的弧度：“我姓韩，韩知渊，寒潭谷内门弟子。听说你在阴阳门演武场上以炼气三层一剑逼退了炼气五层的宗门弟子，剑招使得不错。”
话说得客气，但语气里那股居高临下的审视感比冬日的寒风还刺骨。他顿了顿，话锋一转：“不过，画梅宗不是阴阳门。散修在这里，连外门弟子都不算。我劝你一句——这里不是你出风头的地方。老老实实待在你的客院里，别到处乱走，更别以为攀上了江师叔和苏师妹的关系，就能在这里横着走。”
刘叙白听完这番话，脸上没什么表情。他大致判断出了对方的来意——韩知渊是寒潭谷的人，和苏清欢不是一脉。苏清欢昨天刚回宗门，今天一早寒潭谷的内门弟子就找到客院附近来“劝”他安分守己。这不是巧合。昨晚露台外那行脚印，十有八九和眼前这个人脱不了干系。
“韩师兄的话，晚辈记下了。”刘叙白语气平淡，既不示弱也不呛声，“不过晚辈来画梅宗，是江长老亲自带入山门的。客院也是江长老安排的。韩师兄若觉得晚辈哪里不合规矩，不妨直说。”
韩知渊的眼睛微微眯了起来。他显然没料到一个炼气三层的散修敢用江晴雪来挡他的话。但他城府不浅，没有发作，只是嘴角那丝笑意淡了几分，换上了一副更加意味深长的表情。
“合不合规矩，不是我说了算。不过刘叙白，我给你提个醒——苏师妹当初离开宗门，有些事到现在还没说清楚。你跟她走得近，别人自然会多看你两眼。画梅宗的水，比你想象的要深。你这个修为，一脚踩进去，连个水花都溅不起来。”
他说完这番话，也不等刘叙白回答，径自带着两个随从越过他往下走去。走出几步之后，他又停了一下，侧过头，像是忽然想起什么似的补了一句：“对了，你的剑该换了。拿着把破剑在宗门里走来走去，丢的不只是你自己的脸。”
三个人的脚步声渐渐远去，石阶上恢复了安静。刘叙白站在原地，目送韩知渊的背影消失在石阶下方的松林里，然后低头看了看自己腰间那柄裂纹剑。剑身上的那道裂口在晨光里格外刺目，像是咧着嘴在嘲笑他。
他没生气。韩知渊的话虽然难听，但每一句都是实话。他的修为确实低，他的剑确实破，画梅宗的水确实深，他跟苏清欢走得近确实会被人盯上。这些事他自己早就想明白了。韩知渊今天来，与其说是挑衅，不如说是来探他的底——看看这个从山下带上来的散修，是个沉不住气的愣头青，还是个有脑子的。
刘叙白没有辜负对方的试探。他表现得很稳，至少表面上很稳。
但韩知渊最后那句话——关于苏清欢“当初离开宗门有些事还没说清楚”——让他心里多了一层隐忧。苏清欢离开画梅宗的原因，她在青石镇的时候只说了个大概：筑基突破时被人做了手脚，丹药有问题，她从筑基跌落炼气，险些丧命。但她没有说是谁做的，也没有说是怎么查到的。现在韩知渊说“还没说清楚”，说明这件事在宗门内部至今没有定论。有人还在拿这件事做文章，而苏清欢这次回来，必然会重新搅动这潭浑水。
刘叙白加快了脚步，朝苏清欢的院子走去。
流云峰东侧靠近崖边的那片松林很安静，地上铺着一层厚厚的松针，踩上去软绵绵的没有声响。林中一条窄窄的石径蜿蜒而上，尽头是一处独立的小院。院墙不高，用青石垒成，墙头上覆着薄薄的积雪。院门口那棵歪脖子梅树还没开花，光秃秃的枝杈伸向天空，像一只张开的枯手。树下的石凳上落了满满一层霜，显然很久没人坐过了。
院门虚掩着，里面隐约传出说话的声音。
刘叙白在门口站定，正犹豫要不要敲门，门从里面被拉开了。苏清欢站在门内，已经换上了一身画梅宗内门弟子的标准白底梅袍，长发用银簪绾在脑后，腰间挂着青锋剑。她的气色比在青石镇时好了不少，但眉宇间多了一层回到宗门后才有的冷峻防备。看到是刘叙白，她微微点头，侧身让开。
“进来。”

院子不大，收拾得干干净净。正房三间，东西厢房各一间，院中种着一棵老梅树，比门口那棵歪脖子梅树粗了不止一圈，枝头已经冒出了几粒粉嫩的花苞，在晨风里轻轻颤动。刘叙白跟着苏清欢走进正房的厅堂，桌上放着一壶热茶和几碟点心，显然是她回来之后宗门派人送来的。茶几上还摊着一本翻开的册子，纸页泛黄，像是有些年头的老物。
苏清欢给他倒了杯茶，自己在对面坐下，开门见山：“你碰到谁了？”
刘叙白微微一愣。
“你的脸色比平时绷得紧。”苏清欢端起自己的茶杯，语气平淡得像是在说天气，“在宗门里走一圈，总会碰到不想碰到的人。说吧，是谁？”
刘叙白苦笑了一声。跟苏清欢说话就是这样，你想绕弯子都没机会。他把刚才在石阶上遇到韩知渊的事原原本本说了一遍，包括对方说的每一句话，以及昨晚露台外那行脚印。
苏清欢听完之后，端着茶杯沉默了一会儿。然后她把茶杯放下，手指在杯沿上缓缓转了一圈，开口了。
“韩知渊，寒潭谷大弟子，现任掌教韩百川的亲传弟子。修为筑基中期，擅长双剑。寒潭谷一脉和流云峰一脉面和心不和已经很多年了，但真正撕破脸，是从我离开宗门那件事开始的。”她抬眼看着刘叙白，眼神里没有遮掩，“他今天找你，不是冲你来的。是冲我来的。摸你的底，就是摸我的底。”
“他说的‘还没说清楚的事’是指什么？”
苏清欢沉默了一息，然后指了指茶几上那本泛黄的旧册子。刘叙白这才看清，那不是一本册子，而是一本宗门内务卷宗的誊本。封面上盖着一枚暗红色的印章，印文是“画梅宗内务堂存卷”。
“我昨天夜里去了一趟内务堂的存档阁。”苏清欢的声音压低了半分，但语气依然平静，“这本卷宗记录了去年我离开宗门前后所有相关的内务处置。韩知渊说得没错，到现在都没有定论——当初对我丹药动手脚的人，至今没有查出来。内务堂当时的结论是‘证据不足，暂存待查’。一暂存就存到了现在。”
“你师尊怎么说？”

content_en:
The young man stood at the top of the stone steps and looked down at Liu Xubai. The morning light came from behind him, coating his silver-threaded plum robe with a cold halo, making him look like a silver-rimmed sword—gorgeous, sharp, and unabashedly sharp.
The two disciples behind him also stopped, standing on both sides of the stone steps, one on the left and the other on the right, with their hands folded across their chests, their eyes filled with undisguised scrutiny. The ordinary disciples passing by quickly stepped around and no one dared to stop and watch the excitement.
Liu Xubai sighed in his heart. Less than a day after coming to Hua Mei Zong, trouble started to show up, and the efficiency was even higher than that of the Yin and Yang Sect.
"Exactly." He clasped his fists in a neither humble nor overbearing manner, "Qingshi Town Loose Cultivator Liu Xubai, who is your Excellency?"
The young man didn't return the favor. He just tilted his head slightly and paused for half a breath on the cracked sword on Liu Xubai's waist. A hint of a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth: "My surname is Han, Han Zhiyuan, a disciple of the inner sect of Hantan Valley. I heard that you used a third-level Qi Refining sword to push back the disciples of the fifth-level Qi Refining Sect at the Yin-Yang Sect martial arts field. You are good with your sword skills."
The words were polite, but the condescending scrutiny in his tone was more piercing than the cold wind in winter. He paused and then changed the topic: "However, the Painted Plum Sect is not the Yin Yang Sect. The casual cultivators are here, not even the outer disciples. Let me advise you - this is not a place for you to be in the limelight. Stay in your guest house and don't wander around, let alone think that you can walk around here because you have a relationship with Junior Uncle Jiang and Junior Sister Su."
After hearing these words, Liu Xubai had no expression on his face. He roughly judged the purpose of the other party's visit - Han Zhiyuan was from Hantan Valley and was not of the same lineage as Su Qinghuan. Su Qinghuan just returned to the sect yesterday. Early this morning, the inner disciples from Hantan Valley came near the guest courtyard to "persuade" him to stay safe. This is no coincidence. The line of footprints outside the terrace last night was most likely related to the person in front of me.
"Junior has taken note of what Senior Brother Han said." Liu Xubai's tone was calm, neither showing weakness nor choking, "But Elder Jiang personally brought this junior to the mountain gate to paint Mei Zong. The guest house was also arranged by Elder Jiang. If Senior Brother Han thinks that junior is not in compliance with the rules, you may as well say so."
Han Zhiyuan's eyes narrowed slightly. He obviously didn't expect that a casual cultivator at the third level of Qi Refining would dare to use Jiang Qingxue to block his words. But he was quite wealthy and did not have an attack. However, the smile at the corner of his mouth faded a bit and changed to a more meaningful expression.
"Whether it is in compliance with the rules or not is not up to me. But Liu Xubai, let me remind you - when Junior Sister Su left the sect, some things have not been explained clearly yet. If you get close to her, others will naturally look at you more. The water in the Mei Sect is deeper than you think. With your level of cultivation, if you step in, you won't even get a splash."
After he said this, without waiting for Liu Xubai's reply, he walked past him and walked down with his two followers. After taking a few steps, he paused again, turned his head, and added as if he suddenly remembered something: "By the way, it's time to change your sword. Walking around in the sect with a broken sword will not only embarrass your own face."
The footsteps of the three people gradually faded away, and silence returned to the stone steps. Liu Xubai stood there, watching Han Zhiyuan's back disappear into the pine forest under the stone steps, and then looked down at the cracked sword at his waist. The crack on the sword was particularly dazzling in the morning light, as if it were grinning and laughing at him.
He's not angry. Although Han Zhiyuan's words were unpleasant, every word was true. His cultivation level is indeed low, his sword is indeed broken, the water in Hua Mei Sect is indeed deep, and he will definitely be stared at if he gets close to Su Qinghuan. He had already figured these things out himself. Han Zhiyuan came today, not so much to provoke him, but to find out his background - look at this casual cultivator brought up from the mountain, he is a stupid young man who can't calm down.He is a wise man.
Liu Xubai did not disappoint the other party's temptation. He appeared to be stable, at least on the surface.
But Han Zhiyuan's last words - about Su Qinghuan, "There are some things that I haven't said clearly when I left the sect" - made him feel more worried. The reason why Su Qinghuan left Huamei Sect was only summarized when she was in Qingshi Town: she was tampered with when she broke through the foundation building, there was something wrong with the elixir, she fell from the foundation building and almost died while refining her Qi. But she did not say who did it or how she found it. Now Han Zhiyuan said "it hasn't been made clear yet", indicating that this matter has not yet been finalized within the sect. Some people are still making a fuss about this matter, and Su Qinghuan's return this time will definitely stir up this muddy water again.
Liu Xubai quickened his pace and walked towards Su Qinghuan's yard.
The pine forest on the east side of Liuyun Peak near the cliff is very quiet. The ground is covered with a thick layer of pine needles, which are soft and silent when stepped on. A narrow stone path winds up in the forest, ending at an independent small courtyard. The courtyard wall is not high and is made of bluestone. The top of the wall is covered with a thin layer of snow. The crooked-necked plum tree at the entrance of the courtyard has not yet bloomed, and its bare branches stretch toward the sky, like an open withered hand. The stone bench under the tree was covered with frost, and it was obvious that no one had sat on it for a long time.
The courtyard door was ajar, and voices could be heard faintly inside.
Liu Xubai stood still at the door, hesitating whether to knock on the door, when the door was opened from the inside. Su Qinghuan stood inside the door, having put on the standard white plum robe worn by the inner disciples of the Plum Painting Sect. Her long hair was tied behind her head with a silver hairpin, and a Qingfeng sword hung around her waist. Her complexion was much better than when she was in Qingshi Town, but there was an extra layer of coldness on her brows that she only gained after returning to the sect. Seeing that it was Liu Xubai, she nodded slightly and stepped aside.
"Come in."
The yard is not big and is kept clean. There are three main rooms and one east and west wing. There is an old plum tree planted in the courtyard, which is more than a circle thicker than the crooked-necked plum tree at the door. A few pink flower buds have sprouted from the branches, trembling gently in the morning breeze. Liu Xubai followed Su Qinghuan into the main hall. There was a pot of hot tea and several plates of snacks on the table, which were obviously sent by someone from the sect after she came back. There is an open book spread out on the coffee table, the pages are yellowed, and it looks like an old thing.
Su Qinghuan poured him a cup of tea, sat down across from him, and got straight to the point: "Who did you meet?"
Liu Xubai was slightly startled.
"Your face is tighter than usual." Su Qinghuan picked up her tea cup, her tone as calm as if she was talking about the weather, "When you walk around the sect, you will always meet someone you don't want to meet. Tell me, who is it?"
Liu Xubai smiled bitterly. That's how it is when talking to Su Qinghuan. You don't even have a chance to make any detours. He recounted exactly what happened when he met Han Zhiyuan on the stone steps, including every word he said and the line of footprints outside the terrace last night.
After Su Qinghuan finished listening, she was silent for a while while holding the tea cup. Then she put the tea cup down, slowly moved her fingers around the rim of the cup, and spoke.
"Han Zhiyuan, the eldest disciple of Hantan Valley and the direct disciple of the current headmaster Han Baichuan. He is in the middle stage of foundation building and is good at double swords. The Hantan Valley lineage and the Liuyun Peak lineage have been at odds with each other for many years, but the real rift started when I left the sect." She looked up at Liu Xubai, her eyes unconcealed, "He is looking for you today, not for you. He is for me. To touch your bottom is to touch mine."
"What does he mean by 'things that haven't been made clear yet'?"
Su Qinghuan was silent for a moment, then pointed to the yellowed old book on the coffee table. Only then did Liu Xubai see clearly that it was not a book, but a transcript of the sect's internal affairs file. There is a dark red seal on the cover, with the inscription "Records from the Internal Affairs Hall of the Painted Plum Sect".
"I went to the archives room of the Internal Affairs Hall last night." Su Qinghuan's voice was half lowered.but his tone remained calm, "This dossier records all related internal affairs handling before and after I left the sect last year. Han Zhiyuan is right, there is still no conclusion yet - the person who tampered with my pill has not been found yet. The conclusion of the Internal Affairs Department at that time was 'insufficient evidence, and it is temporarily stored for investigation'. It has been stored until now."
"What did your master say?"
